Introduction

KG, also known as KG Crown or Kiera Grace, is an American singer. She is a former member of the girl group VCHA formed by the survival show "A2K" under JYP Entertainment. She debuted in VCHA on January 26, 2024, with their first single album "Girls of the Year".

On December 7th, 2024, KG filed a lawsuit to terminate her contract with JYP Entertainment and depart from VCHA. Almost a year later, on August 7, 2025, it was announced that KG and JYP Entertainment had reached a mutual agreement on the terms of her contract termination, as part of a court-ordered settlement.
